BrochureContent.Content:
No. 4 The Furze offers well-appointed accommodation throughout, featuring four bedrooms, a converted attic room, detached garden room with sauna and a private rear garden, all within walking distance of local amenities and Monasterevin Train Station.

The ground floor comprises an entrance hall with guest WC and storage closet, a spacious sitting room with bay window and double doors leading to the open-plan kitchen/dining area. The dining area benefits from double doors opening onto the rear garden, while a separate utility room provides additional storage and side access.

Upstairs there are four bedrooms, including a main bedroom with ensuite and fitted wardrobes, along with a family bathroom. A floored attic room on the second floor provides excellent additional space suitable for a variety of uses.

Outside, the rear garden is private, well maintained and not directly overlooked. There is an option to purchase separately a detached garden room, perfect for a home office /gym, also includes a sauna and offers excellent versatility for remote working, fitness or leisure use. To the front, the property benefits from off-street parking.

Ideally located within walking distance of schools, shops, the train station and local amenities, No. 4 The Furze will appeal to families and commuters alike.
